name: A Light in Dark Places
label: Quest
description: A Light in Dark Places: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An eager one, aren't you? If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you.
Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I look forward to your return, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found your way through the dark?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
